page.intro_en: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the list of recommended candidates for the Combined Geo-Scientist Examination 2026. Candidates who appeared for the main examination can now check their results and recommended status across multiple services including Geologist, Hydrogeologist, Geophysicist, Chemist, Scientist B, and Assistant Chemist.
